basic_details.job_title: KASE Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala Academy for Skills Excellence (KASE) is hiring 1 Office Assistant on contract basis. The contract is initially for 01 year, and the consolidated pay is ₹19,510 per month. The essential qualification is a Plus Two pass and a Driving License (must). Online registration through the KASE application form is open from 24 October 2026 until 30 October 2026 (05:00 PM). The walk-in interview is on 2 November 2026, and registration starts at 10:30 am.

how_to_apply: Applications go through the online application form linked in the notice. The website named in the notice is www.kase.in. Online registration opens on 24 October 2026 and closes on 30 October 2026 at 05:00 PM. The notice lists these steps:
Fill in the Online Application Form, completing every relevant field. The notice makes all relevant fields compulsory.
Attach your original certificates: age proof, educational mark sheets and Driving License.
Attach your Curriculum Vitae (CV), resume or bio-data.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. The management reserves the right to cancel or restrict the recruitment process without giving any reason. KASE reserves the right to debar any candidate for malpractice or misconduct, including a fraudulent claim of any kind of benefit, relaxation or concession.

content_sections.heading: About KASE
content_sections.text: On its letterhead, the Kerala Academy for Skills Excellence (KASE) describes itself as the State Skill Development Mission & Skill Secretariat. KASE is a Government of Kerala body. The notice gives its address as Third Floor, Carmel Towers, Vazhuthacaud - 14, which is in Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Plus Two Pass & Driving License (must). Age Limit: 35 Years (Maximum Age) as on 01 Jan 2026. Applicants must also have completed the minimum age of 18 years. Nationality: Applicants must be citizens of India. KASE asks applicants to read the notification carefully and decide for themselves whether they are eligible before applying online. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KASE Office Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications go through the online application form linked in the notice. The website named in the notice is www.kase.in. Online registration opens on 24 October 2026 and closes on 30 October 2026 at 05:00 PM. The notice lists these steps: Fill in the Online Application Form, completing every relevant field. The notice makes all relevant fields compulsory. Attach your original certificates: age proof, educational mark sheets and Driving License. Attach a recent passport-size photograph. Attach your Curriculum Vitae (CV), resume or bio-data.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be told about the selection process, by email or phone call. Shortlisted candidates attend a walk-in interview: Shortlisted candidates must bring the following to the walk-in interview: One self-attested set of educational certificates (SSLC & HSE) Driving License Photo ID proof An updated CV, resume or bio-data One recent passport-sized photograph

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. The management reserves the right to cancel or restrict the recruitment process without giving any reason. KASE reserves the right to debar any candidate for malpractice or misconduct, including a fraudulent claim of any kind of benefit, relaxation or concession.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KASE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KASE has 01 vacancy for the post of Office Assistant, on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KASE Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Online registration closes on 30 October 2026 at 05:00 PM. Registration opened on 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the KASE Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The qualification is Plus Two Pass & Driving License (must).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KASE Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on 01 Jan 2026. Applicants must also have completed the minimum age of 18 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a KASE Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of ₹19,510 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for KASE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Online Application Form linked in the notice and attach your original certificates (age proof, educational mark sheets, Driving License), a recent passport-size photograph and your CV, resume or bio-data.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the KASE Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are told by email or phone call and then attend a walk-in interview. The interview is on 2 November 2026 at Head Quarters, KASE, and registration starts at 10:30 am.

faq.question: Q8. Is the KASE Office Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the job is on contract basis. The contract is initially for 01 year, and any extension depends on performance and requirement.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the KASE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring one self-attested set of educational certificates (SSLC & HSE), your Driving License, photo ID proof, an updated CV, resume or bio-data, and one recent passport-sized photograph.

faq.question: Q10. Will KASE pay TA/DA for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
